description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, including metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption interfaces.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing software build and version information.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for managing and querying various system subsystems and their statuses.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the software.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the hosting application.
